title: PACE：通过智能体自动化实现发布者自适应内容提取
summary: PACE是一个智能体框架，通过LLM分析页面结构并聚合可复用的提取模式，学习发布者特定的提取配置。推理时，配置实例化固定确定性提取器模板，无需额外LLM调用即可实现可扩展提取。实验表明，PACE在文章正文、元数据、图像和表格提取上优于可扩展的非手动基线，接近手动构建的发布者特定解析器质量。
summary_en: PACE is an agentic framework that learns publisher-specific extraction configurations from representative pages using LLMs, then instantiates a fixed deterministic extractor at inference time for scalable extraction without extra LLM calls. Experiments show it outperforms scalable non-manual baselines and approaches manual parsers for article text, metadata, images, and tables.
